songData.lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ritasoul:
God, you made yourself visible in human flesh
Justified and vindicated in the spirit
Seen by angels, and your glorious Gospel is
Preached among the nations
Believed on by many in this world
And taken up in glory

PRE-CHORUS 1
All:
You're amazing, God
The everlasting Saviour
Who dwells with us
Yet lives in us
Almighty King of glory

Nothing compares to your power
The soon-coming King
Your grace abounds
Forever, Lord

The risen King
To you, we sing
Forever, Lord
